# Althor Labs

> I build the software around the model.

Althor Labs is Samuel S’s independent engineering practice in the Washington, D.C. region. Samuel builds AI applications, Microsoft integrations, and workflow software. Althor Consulting LLC is the legal entity.

## Focus areas

- Production infrastructure for AI agent systems
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design and deployment
- Credential brokering for agent tool access
- Policy-gated approval flows for critical actions
- Audit and observability for agent-driven workflows
- Security and audit posture review for agent-driven workflows

## Engagements

- Review an existing system: written findings and proposed changes.
- Build an integration: scope and deliverables agreed before work starts.
- Work with an engineering team: ongoing design and code review.

Remote-first.

- AI Governance Foundation Audit ($2,500, 1 week) — NIST AI RMF gap analysis + Microsoft Foundry control-plane recommendations — https://althorlabs.com/packages/ai-governance-audit/
- MCP Server Security Review ($1,500, 3 days) — written security review of an MCP server against the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 — https://althorlabs.com/packages/mcp-security-review/
- Copilot Studio Agent Quickstart ($5,000, 2 weeks) — working agent + Functions middleware + connector wiring to one enterprise data source — https://althorlabs.com/packages/copilot-studio-quickstart/

- RAG Pipeline Health Check ($300, 1 hour) — live review of embedding, chunking, retrieval, eval — https://althorlabs.com/packages/rag-health-check/

All packages: https://althorlabs.com/packages/
